newsitem.title: USA: USDA eases rules on genetically engineered plants.
newsitem.headline: USDA eases rules on genetically engineered plants.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department said Wednesday it had modified some of its rules on genetically engineered plants.

USDA said the amended regulations would allow broader use of already existing simplified procedures for requests for movement or field tests of modified plants. They also streamline the determination of nonregulated status for plants that closely resemble plants already determined to be safe.
